arxiv-2012-04805.title: microscopic conservation laws for the derivative Nonlinear Schrödinger equation
arxiv-2012-04805.creator: Xingdong Tang, Guixiang Xu
arxiv-2012-04805.description: Abstract . Compared with macroscopic conservation law for the solution of the derivative nonlinear Schrödingger equation (DNLS) with small mass in [ 21 ] , we show the corresponding microscopic conservation laws for the Schwartz solutions of DNLS with small mass.

arxiv-2112-05238.title: Turning Points in the Age-Metallicity Relations — Created by Late Satellite Infall and Enhanced by Radial Migration 2021 Turning Points in the Age-Metallicity Relations — Created by Late Satellite Infall and Enhanced by Radial Migration – D.4
arxiv-2112-05238.creator: Yuxi (Lucy) Lu, Melissa K. Ness, Tobias Buck, Christopher Carr
arxiv-2112-05238.description: Abstract The present-day Age-Metallicity Relation (AMR) is a record of the star formation history of the Galaxy, as this traces the chemical enrichment of the gas over time. We use a zoomed-in cosmological simulation that reproduces key signatures of the Milky Way (MW), g2.

arxiv-2203-15252.title: Identification and classification of exfoliated graphene flakes from microscopy images using a hierarchical deep convolutional neural network
arxiv-2203-15252.creator: Soroush Mahjoubi, Fan Ye, Yi Bao, Weina Meng, Xian Zhang
arxiv-2203-15252.description: Abstract Identification of the mechanically exfoliated graphene flakes and classification of the thickness is important in the nanomanufacturing of next-generation materials and devices that overcome the bottleneck of Moore’s Law. Currently, identification and classification of exfoliated graphene flakes are conducted by human via inspecting the optical microscope images.

arxiv-2205-12699.title: DRLinFluids—An open-source python platform of coupling Deep Reinforcement Learning and OpenFOAM
arxiv-2205-12699.creator: Qiulei Wang, Lei Yan, Gang Hu, Chao Li, Yiqing Xiao, Hao Xiong, Jean Rabault, Bernd R. Noack
arxiv-2205-12699.description: Abstract We propose an open-source python platform for applications of Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) in fluid mechanics. DRL has been widely used in optimizing decision-making in nonlinear and high-dimensional problems. Here, an agent maximizes a cumulative reward with learning a feedback policy by acting in an environment.

arxiv-2209-11593.title: Engineering a heat engine purely driven by quantum coherence
arxiv-2209-11593.creator: Stefan Aimet, Hyukjoon Kwon
arxiv-2209-11593.description: Abstract The question of whether quantum coherence is a resource beneficial or detrimental to the performance of quantum heat engines has been thoroughly studied but remains undecided. To isolate the contribution of coherence, we analyze the performance of a purely coherence-driven quantum heat engine, a device that does not include any heat flow during the thermodynamic cycle.

arxiv-2210-17139.title: Nested Sequents for Intuitionistic Grammar Logics via Structural Refinement Thanks: Work supported by the European Research Council (ERC) Consolidator Grant 771779 (DeciGUT). Affiliation: Computational Logic Group, Institute of Artificial Intelligence, Technische Universität Dresden, Germany
arxiv-2210-17139.creator: Tim S. Lyon
arxiv-2210-17139.description: Abstract Intuitionistic grammar logics fuse constructive and multi-modal reasoning while permitting the use of converse modalities, serving as a generalization of standard intuitionistic modal logics. In this paper, we provide definitions of these logics as well as establish a suitable proof theory thereof.

arxiv-2310-08295.title: If our aim is to build morality into an artificial agent, how might we begin to go about doing so?
arxiv-2310-08295.creator: Reneira Seeamber, Cosmin Badea
arxiv-2310-08295.description: Abstract As Artificial Intelligence (AI) becomes pervasive in most fields, from healthcare to autonomous driving, it is essential that we find successful ways of building morality into our machines, especially for decision-making. However, the question of what it means to be moral is still debated, particularly in the context of AI.

arxiv-2504-09482.title: HalluShift : Measuring Distribution Shifts towards Hallucination Detection in LLMs
arxiv-2504-09482.creator: Sharanya Dasgupta, Sujoy Nath, Arkaprabha Basu, Pourya Shamsolmoali, Swagatam Das
arxiv-2504-09482.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) have recently garnered widespread attention due to their adeptness at generating innovative responses to the given prompts across a multitude of domains. However, LLMs often suffer from the inherent limitation of hallucinations and generate incorrect information while maintaining well-structured and coherent responses.

arxiv-2601-03356.title: Black hole thermodynamics at null infinity Part 2: Open systems, Markovian dynamics and work extraction from non-rotating black holes
arxiv-2601-03356.creator: Antoine Rignon-Bret 1, and Matthieu Vilatte 2, 1 Faculté des Sciences et Technologies Université de Lorraine, Bd des Aiguillettes, 54506 Vandœuvre-lès-Nancy, France 2 Service de Physique de l’Univers, Champs et Gravitation, Université de Mons – UMONS, Place du Parc 20, 7000 Mons, Belgium
arxiv-2601-03356.description: Abstract Abstract Black hole thermodynamics provides a unique setting in which general relativity, quantum field theory, and statistical mechanics converge. In semiclassical gravity, this interplay culminates in the generalized second law (GSL), whose modern proofs rely on information-theoretic techniques applied to algebras of observables defined on null hypersurfaces.

pmc-10575201.title: Local Path Planning for Mobile Robots Based on Fuzzy Dynamic Window Algorithm
pmc-10575201.creator: Ying Sun, Wenlu Wang, Manman Xu, Li Huang, Kangjing Shi, Chunlong Zou, Baojia Chen
pmc-10575201.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Due to the increased employment of robots in modern society, path planning methods based on human–robot collaborative mobile robots have been the subject of research in both academia and industry. The dynamic window approach used in the research of the robot local path planning problem involves a mixture of fixed weight coefficients, which makes it hard to deal with the changing dynamic environment and the issue of the sub-optimal global planning paths that arise after local obstacle avoidance.

pmc-11300611.title: Non-linear finite element analysis of SFRC beam-column joints under cyclic loading: enhancing ductility and structural integrity
pmc-11300611.creator: Umar Ahmad Noor, Muneeb Ahmed Jadoon, Kennedy Onyelowe, Asif Shahzad, Khaled Ghaedi, Hisham Alabduljabbar, Muhammad Faisal Javed
pmc-11300611.description: Brittle shear failure of beam-column joints, especially during seismic events poses a significant threat to structural integrity. This study investigates the potential of steel fiber reinforced concrete (SFRC) in the joint core to enhance ductility and overcome construction challenges associated with traditional reinforcement.

pmc-11437982.title: The mediating effect of TyG-related indicators between long-term exposure to particulate matter and cardiovascular disease: evidence from a national longitudinal cohort study
pmc-11437982.creator: Jiamin Xu, Tongle Yin, Mengshan Pan, Li Qin, Lu Zhang, Xiaoyan Wang, Weijun Zheng, Cuiqing Liu, Rucheng Chen
pmc-11437982.description: BackgroundAmbient particulate matter (PM) exposure is recognized as a risk factor for cardiovascular disease (CVD). However, the extent to which PM exposure is associated with CVD via triglyceride glucose (TyG)-related indicators remains unknown. This study examines the relationship between long-term PM exposure and CVD events, further assessing whether TyG-related indicators mediate this association.

pmc-11510331.title: Interplay of microRNAs and circRNAs in Epithelial Ovarian Cancer
pmc-11510331.creator: Heidi Schwarzenbach
pmc-11510331.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Epithelial ovarian cancer (EOC) with its high death incidence rate is generally detected at advanced stages. During its progression, EOC often develops peritoneal metastasis aggravating the outcomes of EOC patients. Studies on non-coding RNAs (ncRNAs), such as microRNAs (miRNAs) and circular RNAs (circRNAs), have analyzed the impact of miRNAs and circRNAs, along with their interaction among each other, on cancer cells. MiRNAs can act as oncogenes or tumor suppressors modulating post-transcriptional gene expression.

pmc-11860263.title: Self-stigma, career development and employment in young adults with ASD in Chile.
pmc-11860263.creator: M S Burrone, C A Barrientos, D Saa-Ulloa, J Madrid Lira, C Alarcón, C Cortés Rojas, L D Colantonio, M T Solís-Soto
pmc-11860263.description: IntroductionStigma describes prejudicial attitudes, negative stereotypes, and discrimination targeting a subgroup. Various forms of stigma have been identified in the literature, including self-stigma. Self-stigma or internalized stigma occurs when stigmatized individuals become aware of the negative stereotypes and apply these to themselves. Self-stigma may be a barrier to career development and employment in individuals with Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD).

pmc-12434016.title: Immunomodulatory biomaterials in HIV-1 infection prevention, control and treatment
pmc-12434016.creator: Jiaying Li, Huan Tang, Xiaoyi Zhou, Zijun Ni, Yuxin Liang, Xinyue Sun, Xun Zhuang
pmc-12434016.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Acquired Immunodeficiency Syndrome (AIDS), caused by the Human Immunodeficiency Virus (HIV), is a global infectious disease that remains a significant global health challenge. Although antiretroviral therapy (ART) has significantly reduced HIV-1-related morbidity and mortality, it cannot eradicate viral reservoirs latent in host cells and long-term use of ART is also associated with issues such as drug toxicity, drug resistance, and poor patient compliance. Recent achievements in biomaterials have provided new ideas and tools for AIDS prevention, diagnosis, and treatment.

pmc-12462367.title: A novel strategy for nephritis-associated infections: dual-antibacterial/anti-inflammatory effects of Schiff base
pmc-12462367.creator: Yu Zhang, Weiwei Fu, Xiangli Xue
pmc-12462367.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). To address the antimicrobial treatment needs for lupus nephritis and pyelonephritis, this study designed and synthesized ten Schiff base derivatives using 4-(diethylamino)salicylaldehyde as the core scaffold via aldehyde-amine condensation reactions. Activity screening identified compound D5 as exhibiting potent antibacterial activity against Staphylococcus aureus ATCC 29213 with an MIC of 8 μg mL−1, demonstrating low cytotoxicity toward mammalian cells (HK-2, LO2) and no hemolysis at 256 μg mL−1.

pmc-12469173.title: Mustardé Cheek Rotation-Advancement Flap: A Case-Based Experience in Reconstruction of a Large Defect of the Lower Eyelid Due to Squamous Cell Carcinoma
pmc-12469173.creator: Kostadin Gigov, Ivan Ginev, Petra Kavradzhieva
pmc-12469173.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Background: Restoring the integrity of the lower eyelid presents a complex surgical challenge due to its lamellar structure and the high risk of complications. Among these, ectropion is the most frequent and troublesome outcome. Objective: This study aims to present a case of lower eyelid reconstruction following the excision of squamous cell carcinoma using Mohs micrographic surgery combined with the Mustardé cheek rotation flap technique, highlighting its advantages, limitations, and applicability in elderly patients.

pmc-12502304.title: Currently managed US prevalence of cutaneous venous malformations (cVMs): a nationally representative, retrospective, real-world, subject-blinded, physician-observational probability study
pmc-12502304.creator: Jack Ray Gallagher, Susan Carroll, Jeffrey Martini, Michael Kelly, Maria Gnarra Buethe
pmc-12502304.description: BackgroundCutaneous venous malformations (cVMs) are rare vascular anomalies characterized by progressive vessel ectasia, leading to disfigurement, pain, ulceration, and bleeding. These lesions often evade early detection and are notoriously difficult to treat due to the limited dermal bioavailability of systemic therapies. Unlike deep venous malformations, cVMs present unique management challenges and currently lack FDA-approved treatments.

pmc-12578954.title: Sports Participation 25 Years After Anterior Cruciate Ligament Reconstruction: A Prospective Longitudinal Study Comparing Patients With Patellar Tendon and Hamstring Tendon Grafting to Uninjured Controls
pmc-12578954.creator: Susan L Keays, Peter A Newcombe, Anthony C Keays, Daniel B Mellifont, Natalie J Collins
pmc-12578954.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Background:Approximately 55% of individuals return to previous sports levels after anterior cruciate ligament (ACL) reconstruction (ACLR), but the duration of their sporting life post-ACLR and how this differs from uninjured sports participants is unknown.Purpose:To trace the 25-year trajectory of sports participation in individuals who have undergone ACLR and compare sporting activity between graft types and between ACLR individuals and uninjured controls.Study Design:Cohort study; Level of evidence, 3.Methods:A total of 62 individuals (44 males; mean age, 27 years) underwent ACLR (31 bone–patellar tendon–bone

pmc-12736507.title: Development and Application of Miniaturized Multispectral Detection System for Water Reflection Detection
pmc-12736507.creator: Yuze Song, Yunfei Li, Chao Li, Feng Luo, Fuhong Cai
pmc-12736507.description: Spectroscopic technology offers the advantage of rapid online monitoring and has attracted significant attention in molecular detection. However, the complex optical spectroscopic structure results in a relatively complex structure for spectral detection systems, limiting their widespread application. In water spectral detection, in addition to ensuring the stability of the optical system, waterproofing is also crucial.

pmc-12953175.title: Clinical Reasoning‐Led Physiotherapy Intervention for Biceps Tendinopathy: A Case Report
pmc-12953175.creator: Siddiqua Syeda Ummul, Kazi Md Azman Hossain, Fabiha Alam, Saleha Fazal, Farzana Sharmin, Md. Mafrohi Sattar, Md. Ershad Ali
pmc-12953175.description: Long head of biceps tendinopathy (LHBT) is a common source of anterior shoulder pain, often misdiagnosed due to overlapping symptoms with other shoulder disorders. This case report presents a 56‐year‐old female with chronic shoulder pain managed through a clinical reasoning‐guided physiotherapy program. Assessment using clinical reasoning, including the International Classification of Functioning, Disability, and Health (ICF) framework, confirmed LHBT.

pmc-12957896.title: Non‐Surgical Hip Augmentation With a PDLLA–Hyaluronic Acid
pmc-12957896.creator: Han Earl Lee, Jovian Wan, Ki Woong Yu, Jong Keun Song, Isabella Rosellini, Sebastien Garson, Hugues Cartier, Benjamin Ascher, Kyu‐Ho Yi
pmc-12957896.description: BackgroundHip contouring is experiencing growing demand within aesthetic medicine, a trend particularly pronounced in Asian populations where cultural preferences emphasize harmoniously proportioned feminine silhouettes. While surgical augmentation remains an option, its inherent procedural risks and protracted recovery periods underscore the need for effective minimally invasive alternatives. Volumetric enhancement using biostimulatory agents, such as poly‐D,L‐lactic acid (PDLLA), constitutes a non‐surgical approach.

pmc-13010068.title: Development and Evaluation of SNOMED CT Automated Mapping Tool: Advancing Terminology Standardization and Semantic Interoperability
pmc-13010068.creator: Youngsun Park, Hannah Kang, Jiwon Kim, Soo-Yong Shin, Dosang Cho, Sang Youl Rhee, Hong Seok Park, Kyung-Jae Lee, Sungchul Bae, Andrew Coristine, Sumi Sung, Kola Adegoke, Karen Triep, Dillon Chrimes
pmc-13010068.description: BackgroundEffective secondary use of healthcare data is hindered by fragmentation and a lack of semantic interoperability due to heterogeneous local terminologies. Standardizing clinical terms using SNOMED CT (Systematized Nomenclature of Medicine Clinical Terms) is essential but remains a manual, labor-intensive, and inconsistent process, especially across multiple institutions.

pmc-13338144.title: Multi-method synergistic determination of the development height of the water-conducting fractured zone in the 82,209 working face
pmc-13338144.creator: Zenghui Liu, Haonan Li
pmc-13338144.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Accurate determination of the water-conducting fractured zone (WCFZ) height is critical for preventing roof water inrush in coal mines. Taking the 82,209 near-horizontal fully mechanized caving face of the No. 22 coal seam in Lijiayao Coal Mine as the research object, we established a multi-method synergistic system combining empirical formula calculation, key strata theory prediction, surface borehole field measurement and numerical simulation. Empirical formulas produce highly scattered results (32.94–135.00 m) and are only suitable for preliminary estimation.

pmc-13553440.title: Visual metaphors promote place bonding in urban marathon participation through emotional involvement and spatial meaning reconstruction: a ZMET–PLS-SEM study
pmc-13553440.creator: Yuchen Wang, Hongcai Song, Jiangsu Lu, Jie Wei
pmc-13553440.description: IntroductionUrban marathon participation provides a real-world mass-participation and active leisure setting in which runners perceive environmental cues through continuous bodily movement and visual attention. However, how event-based environmental cues are transformed into emotional involvement, the psychological reconstruction of spatial meaning, and place bonding remains insufficiently explained.

pmc-13571893.title: Factors Associated With Menopause Symptoms: A Systematic Review and Meta‐Analysis
pmc-13571893.creator: Janice Hoang, Kathryn Halliday, Deborah Allen, Wema Meranda Mtika, Eve Tranter, Grace Glover, Lynn Tatnell, Julia Hippisley‐Cox, Carol Coupland, Sarah Hillman, Jennifer Hirst
pmc-13571893.description: BackgroundMenopause, marked by hormonal decline and menstrual cessation, is associated with various symptoms. Socio‐demographic and behavioural factors may influence symptom type and severity. Understanding these associations can inform better symptom management.ObjectivesTo identify factors associated with the presence and severity of menopausal symptoms through systematic review and meta‐analysis.
